resources.string: This build has no Hi VPN service configured. You can connect to your own WireGuard server from the Servers tab.
Hi VPN accounts are anonymous: no email, just an account number. Keep it safe; it is the only way to sign in.
This device\'s VPN key is revoked on the server and removed from this phone. You need your account number to sign in again.
This device has a new WireGuard key and the old one was revoked. Reconnect to use it.
The key could not be replaced. Check your connection and try again.
This is shown once. Anyone with this number can use your account.
That account number was not recognised, or the service could not be reached.
The account could not be created. Try again shortly.
DNS, MTU, routing, LAN access and split tunneling
To connect at startup without opening the app, use Always-on VPN below.
Only Android can block all traffic when the VPN is down. Open VPN settings, tap the gear next to Hi VPN, and turn on \"Always-on VPN\" and \"Block connections without VPN\".
Require fingerprint, face or screen lock to open Hi VPN. The VPN keeps running while locked.
IP, DNS, IPv6 and leak checks, latency and speed

Connection profiles, preferences, favourite servers, the cached server list and daily traffic totals. Your WireGuard private keys and account number are encrypted with a key held by Android\'s Keystore. None of this is backed up to the cloud.
A hash of your account number, your plan, and each device\'s public key and tunnel address. Not stored: the sites you visit, DNS queries, traffic content, your real IP address, or connection times.
